1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 9 m de altura, de hojas alternas, elípticas, flores solitarias de color amarillo y fruto en baya; sus hojas sirven de alimento al ganado vacuno y caballar. Salicaceae, Banara vanderbiltii.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 9 m, with alternate, elliptical leaves, solitary yellow flowers, and fruit in a berry; its leaves serve as food for cattle and horses. Salicaceae, Banara vanderbiltii.
